name: Douzenier Le Page

intro.text: I'm a douzenier, a member of the parish Douzaine, twelve of us, elected. We set the parish rates, and we'll thank you to stay off the verge.

win: I'll note it in the minutes. Fair and square.
after: The States of Guernsey run the island, but each parish still has its twelve. A very old system, and very good at making tea last through a meeting.
